Use case: ads-marketing. Produce ONE finished Xiaohongshu promotional poster, not a contact sheet and not a phone screenshot. Portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, target 1536 by 2048 pixels, full bleed, high resolution, print-quality Chinese typography, minimum 5 percent safe margins. This is an advertisement for the user's actual PTCG practice application PtcgDeckAgent. Reference image 1 is its genuine blue/gold square app icon: preserve recognizable icon content and use it small. Reference image 2 is its genuine version 0.6.1 desktop home screen: use its actual visible contents as a clearly framed supporting inset/device screen; do not invent product functionality or rewrite its interface. The rest of the poster should be your original art direction and NOT a repeated copy of the screenshot composition.
Text requirements: all Chinese must be accurate simplified Chinese, sharp and easy to read at mobile-feed scale. Exactly display product name "PtcgDeckAgent" (case-sensitive) and small version "v0.6.1". Display these THREE complete selling points, each exactly once, using sensible line breaks and emphasizing the numbers:
"全面支持简中30周年环境新卡"
"AI策略平台 · 对战赛博训练家"
"内置18.5多套卡组 · 直接开玩"
These are the client's supplied claims. No extra claims, no fabricated numbers, no win-rate promises, no official authorization badge, no QR codes, no price or URL. The poster needs only a large headline in addition to those three selling points, brand and version. Full visual design, sophisticated spacing, no watermarks, no stock photo montage, no random Latin decoration, no spelling mistakes, no tiny unreadable feature text. Do not add a Xiaohongshu logo or fake social media controls.

A very large tasteful 30周年 typographic motif. Three selling points in separate clean generous horizontal type bands toward lower half. Premium crisp metal light without generic dashboard cards. Brand icon small top left, exact wordmark beside it. Hero and text extremely prominent; avoid overloading neon details.
